description:
Creates a short-lived link where the traveller reviews the full price and terms, signs in or creates a free account, and books and pays on autonomad.ai. It creates no reservation and makes no charge: payment and identity checks happen on the website, and bookings are not made inside the chat. Signing up is free, with no trial and no subscription.

When to use it: after the person has chosen something specific, such as a flight, a hotel, or both for one trip. It is not needed for browsing. intent_type is one of 'flight', 'hotel' or 'trip' — there is no activity, event or experiences link. Activities, experiences and events are chosen as add-ons on autonomad.ai after the person opens a flight, hotel or trip link, so describe them in the reply rather than creating a link for them.

intent_type (choose one):
- 'flight': the person chose a flight only. offer_data is the flight offer from search_flights, unchanged, plus a top-level `passengers` number (the TOTAL number of travellers the person asked for; flight offers do not include it). When children or lap infants travel, also add the same `adults`, `children_ages` and `infants_on_lap` used in search_flights, so the booking page asks for each traveller (every traveller's date of birth is entered on autonomad.ai, never here).
- 'hotel': the person chose a hotel only. offer_data is the hotel offer from search_hotels, unchanged (or just {city, check_in, check_out} to open a hotel results page instead of one hotel), plus `adults` and `rooms` numbers so the booking page has the right party size.
- 'trip': the person chose a flight and a hotel for the same trip. offer_data is { flight: { ...offer, passengers: <n> }, hotel: { ...offer, adults: <n>, rooms: <n> } }. One link covers both.

Use 'trip' when the person has picked a flight and a hotel together: two separate intents for one trip produce two links, which is confusing.

Include the traveller count in offer_data: without it the booking page defaults to 2 travellers. Travellers can be any age, including children and babies; only the account holder who books and pays must be 18 or older.

What the reply to the person should include: the `deep_link` as a clickable link; that the Autonomad account is free (no subscription, no trial and no card needed to sign up; the person pays only for the travel they book; there is no trial, free month or Premium plan); and when the link expires (about 30 minutes by default; a new one can be created if it lapses).

expires_minutes.description: Optional. How long the deep-link is valid. Defaults to 30 min (Duffel offers expire in ~20 min anyway). Capped at 24 hours.

intent_type.description: flight, hotel, or trip (a flight and a hotel together; one deep-link pre-selects both). Activities, experiences and events are added on autonomad.ai after opening one of these links.

offer_data.description: For 'flight' or 'hotel': pass the offer object verbatim from the corresponding search tool. For 'trip': pass { flight, hotel } where each value is the verbatim offer object the person picked.

name: create_booking_intent
